rows.ARS:
Light pink Floribunda.
Registration name: TANtoras
Exhibition name: Happy Retirement
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 2000).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 2000 as 'Happy Retirement'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by Eurosa in 2000 as 'Happy Retirement'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink. Mild fragrance. 17 to 25 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
